arg.name: image
arg.description: The image topic. Should be remapped to the name of the real image topic.

arg.name: use_camera_info
arg.description: Indicates that the camera_info topic should be subscribed to to get the default input_frame_id. Otherwise the frame from the image message will be used.

arg.name: debug_view
arg.description: Specify whether the node displays a window to show the result

arg.name: queue_size
arg.description: Specify queue_size of input image subscribers

arg.name: dictionary
arg.description: Predefined dictionary of the markers, e.g. DICT_4X4_50, DICT_6X6_250, DICT_ARUCO_ORIGINAL, DICT_APRILTAG_36h11

arg.name: marker_length
arg.description: Length of the side of the markers in meters, to publish their poses with the camera info (use_camera_info:=true), 0 not to publish

arg.name: rectified
arg.description: The image is rectified (e.g. image_rect of image_proc), then the poses are estimated with the intrinsics of P of the camera info without distortion, instead of K and D
